name: compiler_context
core: All four modules require ~=0.4.3. Nonreentrancy on: cdp.vy, cdp_native.vy, cdp_erc20.vy; off: erc20.vy. src/ministable.vy and ERC20 harness bind and export the modules. moccasin.toml and pyproject.toml do not pin compiler, optimizer, or EVM settings. Local .venv cannot import vyper. Deployed compiler and build settings not verified.
